baseline.hubScore: 83.5/100 provisional; detail pages have no complete independent 23-criterion score
baseline.defect: The shared detail template held the only official club website link below the hero, gallery and introduction (often over 1200-1800px down mobile). Ten records had golf.bookingUrl, but none was rendered in the detail template; the National is private and had no bookingUrl. The address fact was labelled Access.

hypothesis: An early, source-scoped action with truthful course-specific eligibility and booking labels will let visitors reach current club information before scrolling through photography without implying that a private course is publicly bookable.
boundedChange: Move the 11 direct operator visitor-source entries into one shared map used by hub and detail, retaining the visitor-access-only 5 Oct 2026 check scope.

Place a compact golf-only Plan your round panel after the H1 and before the hero. Use six club-linked booking URLs for public tee times; use official policy/visitor pages for National, Flinders, Mornington, Sorrento and Portsea with specific labels.
Give Dunes readers a separate official rates link beside the booking calendar because main and Cups rates differ.
Relabel the golf address fact Address while leaving other experience types unchanged.
metric: All 11 detail routes have an accurate, visible first-screen operator action at 320/390px, minimum 44px targets, no horizontal overflow or JS errors at mobile and desktop sizes; private National never shows a public booking claim; 11 golf hub cards and dated source notes remain unchanged.
rollback: Revert the shared-source extraction and golf-only detail panel if visitor task, factual route or visual hierarchy degrades; preserve operator source URLs in the existing main-branch snapshot.
independentReview: Existing independent UX reviewer identified the buried link and warned against a universal tee-time label. Independent access/facts reviewer verified all 11 proposed action URLs and labels against operator sources; no misleading destination found. Final independent UX preview passed all 11 at 320/390/1440: first-screen 44px or greater actions, keyboard focus/new-tab behavior, National eligibility, Dunes separate rates, no non-golf regression. Final independent visual preview passed representative National, Flinders, Portsea, Dunes and Mornington at 320/390/1440: clear title-panel-hero hierarchy, 44-45px targets, visible focus, clean wrapping and no overflow. These are local reviews, not live scores.
